children.text: Isolated AST: AST above the lab's range for age, ALT normal.
Hemolyzed sample? Red cells release AST. Redraw by clean venipuncture before anything else.

children.cond: Low platelets, large spleen, or abnormal GGT, direct bilirubin or INR
children.subtext: Not isolated — possible liver disease: follow Elevated Transaminases

children.cond: Dark or cola urine, muscle pain, swelling or weakness

pill.text: Emergency department now: CK, creatinine, potassium, urinalysis

children.cond: Heart failure, fainting, or chest pain with breathlessness
New murmur or chest pain, otherwise well
Pallor, jaundice or dark urine with anemia

pill.text: Hemolysis workup today: CBC, reticulocytes, LDH, haptoglobin, bilirubin, DAT

children.cond: Coombs-negative hemolysis, jaundice, low ALP — sick child

pill.text: Think acute Wilson disease: INR now; call hepatology / transplant center now

children.text: Repeat AST and ALT with CK, LDH, CBC with reticulocytes, TSH and free T4 (First contact).
No strenuous exercise for ≥ 7 days (longer after heavy training) before the repeat — ask about sport and weight training.
Newborn: CK is high after delivery and birth trauma — repeat before any referral.

children.subtext: Treat hypothyroidism; recheck CK and AST once euthyroid

children.cond: Recent strenuous exercise or muscle injury
children.subtext: Rest ≥ 7 days, then repeat CK and AST

children.cond: Boy, no exertion (beyond the newborn period)

pill.text: Neuromuscular referral: Duchenne or Becker testing — no liver workup, no biopsy

children.cond: Girl, or weakness, rash or myalgia

pill.text: Neuromuscular or rheumatology referral: myositis, metabolic myopathy

children.subtext: Treat hypothyroidism; recheck AST and CK once euthyroid

children.cond: Anemia, high reticulocytes or LDH, low haptoglobin

children.text: Macro-AST: AST bound to immunoglobulin, too large to clear. Child well; ALT, CK and LDH normal.
Check AST in both parents — familial forms are common.
Ask the lab for polyethylene glycol (PEG) precipitation of AST; electrophoresis confirms.

pill.text: No imaging, no biopsy — letter to family and primary care
